text_block_list.text:
It's a new year, and Т.М. Опера О finds
herself in
a completely new situation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look at Мэйсё Дото! A second place
finish!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She's steadily built herself up from a
no-name
newcomer to now proving
herself capable of the
graded races!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Huff... I... made it... somehow... I'm getting there, little by little.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Oh, oh! Look at the TV, Trainer! It's Doto! Our Doto!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Any moment now, I guarantee she'll
come through
that door to thank me for
all I've done to spur her
growth!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: OPERA OOOOO!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
What did I say? Now, Doto, shower me
with
grateful adoration!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Um... I do feel grateful, but there's
something
more important right now.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
A press conference is about to start...
Special
Week, Грасс Вандер, and El
Condor Pasa are all
there.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
What? The older generation's three
musketeers
are speaking to the press?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming, everybody! We have

something important to say!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The three of us, myself, Грасс Вандер,
and El
Condor Pasa...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...won't be running in next year's Twinkle
Series!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you're bowing out after
this year?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
No, we feel we have accomplished all we
can at
this level and wish to compete in
the Dream
Trophy League.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ciao, everybody! Wait, is this goodbye?!
Will we
ever see each other again?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Waaahhh!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
El, we aren't quitting. Don't give them
the wrong
idea.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
So, three stalwarts of the Twinkle Series
are
moving on to the next league.
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
What does this mean for next year? I
hope it
doesn't start a downward spiral...
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text: Kgh! Argh, grrrrr!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How can those three be advancing to
the next
stage? Ahh, that's not even
their most
unforgivable transgression...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
They've stolen my spotlight! Even
though we're all
seniors!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My kingdom is in ruins... I must reclaim
my seat as
the main actor.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, start preparations immediately.
I'll be
having a press conference of my
own!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
What about? Ha ha ha! Did you expect
me to
know?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I'll be figuring that out right now, of
course.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? But if we don't have an idea...
Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Reluctantly, I schedule a press
conference for
tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Attention, all adoring fans of
Umamusume!
Honorable members of the
press! You have
recently been made
aware of the departure of
three certain
persons.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But a year remains until then. New
royalty must
therefore be crowned in the
interim.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So, who will inherit their throne? Who, I
say?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Allow me to provide the answer! It will
be none
other than me, Т.М. Опера О!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: For I am the Overlord! Haaah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: O-okay...
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
Opera O's logic doesn't add up, but her

overwhelming enthusiasm holds
everyone's
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I swear, here and now, that over the next
year I
will build a track record befitting
the ruler of the
next age.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho, the Japan Cup, and the
Arima
Kinen—I shall conquer every G1
race and build
my dynasty!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The chaotic age of vying competitors is
at an end.
A singular king shall unite the
realm under one
throne.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, the curtain has risen to reveal my
reign! This
is no sunset, but the dawn of
an era!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Witness the birth of a new ruler!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
Her bold declaration is met with oohs
and aahs
from the audience. After
entering her senior year,
it seems her
skills in stage performance have

improved too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opera O is... amazing. I mean, she could
cheer up
Ayabe before, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Now she's even more amazing... She made everyone go "wow"... Uuungh...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I wish she'd see me as someone to
compete with.
I've grown stronger too...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I don't have the courage though... I can't
tell her,
I just can't...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Then, once I have successfully taken my
place at
the top...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series will know peace as a

flourishing kingdom for a millennium to
come!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
So you see, the three heroes bidding
farewell are
already irrelevant.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Usher them out the door with a goodbye
and
adieu! Aaaah ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Someone here's lookin' for trouble, huh?
Well,
she's definitely found it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Grass, so long as we're around, we can't
let her
win!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, yes. She'll soon realize who
she's really
up against.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
All right, I've got some trainin' to do!
Nos vemos!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It seems El hasn't realized yet, but...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I understand the real reason you held
this press
conference, Opera O...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Though you might not have been aware
of it
yourself, it was for the sake of the
disheartened
fans.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
But thank you. I'm glad the younger
generation
has you among their ranks.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Now, my declaration is complete,
Trainer! The
starring role is mine once
again.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I have crossed the Rubicon! All that
remains is to
run my way to becoming
the Centurial Overlord
by the end of this
year! Haaah ha ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A sudden announcement from three
popular
Umamusume threatened to take
the wind out of
the Twinkle Series'
sails...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Т.М. Опера О's declaration instantly

breathed new life into them. A year of

pulse-pounding races between the
generations
await!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
